key_highlights: David Jones enters voluntary administration following failed landlord negotiations, creating counterparty distress across retail landlords and suppliers.
ASX registers an $80b post-US midterms relief rally, though sector performance remains sharply bifurcated with NextDC surging and NAB diving.
RBA maintains hawkish posture on sticky inflation and persistent excess demand, heightening correction risks across residential housing and mortgage lending.
Qantas flags an estimated $1b fuel cost surge, initiating airfare hikes and capacity discipline despite volatile global crude prices.
Junior mining and gold exploration equities see heightened liquidity via active institutional and broker-led equity capital raisings.

sectors.trend: Severe solvency pressures and restructuring following David Jones' administration and store closures.
sectors.implications: Downside risks for major commercial landlords (SCG.AX, VCX.AX, GPT.AX) via lease renegotiations, vacancy spikes, and supply-chain debtor write-downs.

sectors.trend: Secular outperformance driven by global AI capacity demands and post-US election political de-risking.
sectors.implications: Premium valuations sustained for hyperscale digital infrastructure providers such as NextDC (NXT.AX).

sectors.trend: Pockets of sharp selling pressure and margin sensitivity highlighted by NAB's steep decline.
sectors.implications: Headwinds for the major banks (NAB.AX, CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX) as borrowing capacity constraints and housing risks slow mortgage credit growth.

sectors.trend: Active capital markets supporting junior gold, silver, and battery metal exploration programs.
sectors.implications: Selective speculative momentum in micro/mid-cap explorers (CHN.AX, BPM.AX, AGC.AX, KNI.AX), while large-cap diversified miners watch macroeconomic demand.

sectors.trend: Operational margin squeeze from a $1b fuel bill surge countering headline crude oil declines.
sectors.implications: Qantas (QAN.AX) forced to lift ticket pricing and curtail capacity, risking demand destruction if consumer real incomes stay constrained.

key_themes: Macroeconomic divergence between global AI momentum and domestic consumer slowdown
Counterparty credit and tenancy contagion from marquee retail collapses
Hawkish RBA monetary policy backdrop curbing housing affordability and credit demand
Resource sector financing rebound led by gold and exploration equity raisings

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Commercial Landlord Exposure to Major Retail Tenant Collapse
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight retail REITs with exposure to regional/CBD department stores; reallocate toward prime logistics and industrial assets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Prolonged RBA Restrictiveness & Residential Housing Correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Trim exposures to high-multiple domestic banks (NAB.AX, CBA.AX); maintain higher cash balances and short-duration fixed income.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Aviation Fuel Cost Inflation & Travel Volume Softening
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce cyclical exposure to transport operators; hedge jet fuel volatility through energy sector holdings.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Gig Economy Regulatory Liabilities and Tax Compliance
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review corporate exposure to platform-based labor models subject to payroll tax rulings.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight digital infrastructure and cloud data centres
opportunities.rationale: Strong structural AI demand insulates operators from domestic macroeconomic headwinds and retail weakness.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective positioning in well-funded junior gold and base metals explorers
opportunities.rationale: High broker appetite and recent equity raises provide operational runway for drill catalysts.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Divest or hedge exposure to discretionary retail landlords and suppliers
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones administration increases tenant vacancy rates and threatens supplier recovery rates.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-valuation major banks amid margin compression and housing headwind
defensive_moves.rationale: NAB's sell-off signals rising sensitivity to high interest rate credit quality risks and slowing mortgage expansion.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound and volatile; index-level relief from US midterms will contend with domestic retail insolvencies and bank margin caution.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued expansion as high interest rates, borrowing capacity cuts, and household budget pressures constrain broader GDP and earnings growth.
